subject: Re: MAP and evaluation-kit access / close cadence
messages:
From: Arielle Park <arielle.park@solaris-analytics.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: diego.ramos@solaris-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + eval-kit access request

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Solaris is ready to move toward a short pilot (3–4 week) to validate inference cost and quality for our product recommendations workload. To get our legal and ops teams comfortable, we need a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out deliverables and a gated access plan for your evaluation artifacts (prompt packs, testcases, and a small labelled sample dataset).

Key asks from our side:
- A clear timeline with acceptance gates and a takedown procedure for datasets/testcases.
- Usage constraints (ephemeral access, non-repurposing, no index in customer corpora).
- A list of attachments you’ll provide and formats.
- Point of contact for SOC2/security Qs if we need artifact-level evidence.

Can you share a draft MAP and the minimal promptpack + sample testcases we can run in our staging environment? We prefer a short hard stop — if we don’t hit acceptance criteria by the pilot end, all materials should be destroyed per the MAP.

Thanks,
Arielle Park
Head of Data Science, Solaris Analytics
arielle.park@solaris-analytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0184

---
Note: we may need to loop procurement for a short evaluation order once the MAP is agreed.

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Arielle Park <arielle.park@solaris-analytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + eval-kit access request

Arielle —

Appreciate the clear asks. Attaching a concise MAP draft and a minimal promptpack README that outlines what we’ll share and the access model. High-level plan below (we’ll put details in the MAP PDF):

1) Timeline and gates (3 weeks pilot):
   - Week 0 (kickoff): NDA/MAP countersign and provisioning of ephemeral sandbox (Redwood-hosted tenant).
   - Week 1: Promptpack & 1k sample testcases provisioned (ephemeral keys, no export).
   - Week 2: Joint run and qualitative checks; minor prompt tweaks allowed.
   - Week 3: Acceptance window (latency/cost targets + quality thresholds). If acceptance fails, automatic takedown + confirmation of data deletion.

2) Usage constraints (short):
   - Materials are provided for evaluation only; no derivation or indexing into production corpora.
   - Ephemeral credentials expire at pilot end; any derived scoring logs for debugging are retained for 30 days and then destroyed unless otherwise agreed.
   - Customer may request an on-site/air-gapped transfer under enterprise contract only.

3) Attachments we’re providing now (sample versions):
   - redwood-eval-kit-instructions.pdf (how to run the promptpack in sandbox)
   - promptpack-sample-README.txt (includes 10 representative prompts + expected format)
   - Solaris-MAP-v1.pdf (MAP draft with gates and takedown steps)

4) Security contacts and evidence:
   - Primary: marissa_cole@redwood.ai (security/compliance lead for eval exchanges).
   - We can provide artifact-level provenance (hashes, audit log excerpts) on request; SOC2 artifacts available via our portal.

Next steps: please confirm the pilot start date you’d prefer and whether procurement needs a PO before we provision the sandbox. We’ll attach a short MPA draft for legal review (no fees for this pilot beyond usage-based tokens).

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Manager — Redwood Inference
T: +1 (650) 555-3221
E: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai

Attachments: Solaris-MAP-v1.pdf; promptpack-sample-README.txt; redwood-eval-kit-instructions.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Arielle Park <arielle.park@solaris-analytics.com>, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + eval-kit access request

Arielle — quick procurement note from our side.

We can proceed without a PO for the sandbox provisioning if Solaris signs the attached MPA (minor redlines expected). If procurement requires a PO, we’ll hold sandbox access until the PO is issued — that typically adds 5–7 business days. Either path is fine; tessa, please advise on the default pilot cadence if we do not wait for a PO.

Also attaching a draft MPA (MPA-draft-SOLARIS.docx) that mirrors the MAP PDF but includes the terms procurement will reference. Key items: data takedown clause, ephemeral credential expiry, and a single-evaluation-license limited to the pilot.

Ben Carter
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-1122

Attachment: MPA-draft-SOLARIS.docx

From: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@solaris-analytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Arielle Park <arielle.park@solaris-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + eval-kit access request

Ben / Tessa —

Thanks — Solaris prefers to start the pilot week of July 26. Procurement can sign the MPA (we will push for the PO after the MPA is countersigned). We confirm the following:

- Pilot start: 2026-07-26 (kickoff).
- Acceptance criteria: we'll use the latency and precision thresholds in Solaris-MAP-v1.pdf (Arielle will confirm exact numbers tomorrow).
- We agree to the ephemeral access model and 30-day debug log retention.

Please send the DocuSign link for the MPA and a shared Drive folder where we can access the sample promptpack and 1k testcases once provisioned.

Diego Ramos
VP Engineering, Solaris Analytics
diego.ramos@solaris-analytics.com
+1 (212) 555-4492
